text:
mike: quick check — BareCloud just replied with a 3-week provisioning ETA for the h100 rack. any cheap short-term options to cover a scheduled demo next Wed? :grimacing:
jin: how many concurrent hosts do you need for the demo?
mike: need ~4 GPUs with <100ms p99 for the demo workload, basically interactive inference.
sara: can we borrow from the demo pool or spin ephemeral on cloud vendor? what region?
mike: us-west2 preferred. demo customers are in PST.
jin: spots: we have 2 reserved h100s in west but not evenly spread across tenants. we could: 1) reassign a non-critical demo slot, 2) temporary dedicated on BareCloud (3w ETA), 3) burst on public clouds (costy).
ash: @sara tagging procurement — can we request a short-term lease or a demo swap from other teams?
sara: pinged procurement email, they asked for exact hours and tenant IDs. can you paste tenant id?
mike: tenant-2247. Demo window: 2026-04-01 14:00-16:00 PDT.
ash: finance note: if we do cloud burst, estimate ~ $4k for 2 hours incl reserved IPs.
ash: also, we have a soft quota on the GCP project — might need a quick quota bump.
jin: for GCP, you can query current quotas: ```gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --project=redwood-demo | grep GPUs -A2```
mike: tried that, shows GPUs: 0/8 used, but quota type is "preemptible-only" for the project. not good for demo.
oncall: oncall here — we can temporarily flip another project's quota if you have admin perms, but need an approval email before we change cross-project assignments.
sara: procurement said BareCloud has a short cancellation window if vendor can shuffle their incoming racks; they asked for a written justification. I'll draft.
nash: quick idea: can we run a 4-GPU H100 job across two nodes with model sharding? might reduce strict latency but could work for demo.
jin: possible, but p99 will spike because of cross-node comms. only acceptable if we lower batch size and demo tolerates occasional lag.
mike: demo flow is interactive chat — audience notices lag. prefer single-node.
sara: I got vendor reply: "We can prioritize your rack to next cycle if we get PO and wire transfer within 48h."
mike: who owns PO?
sara: procurement + @ash.
ash: finance (ash) here — we can do expedited PO but need headcount justification + demo importance. can you add a one-paragraph justification and expected ARR impact?
mike: adding: "Demo is with strategic integrator expected to convert to a Dedicated contract >$200k ARR. Need single-node h100 to validate latency SLA in their environment"
nash: good. I'll approve expedited PO once procurement attaches vendor quote.
sara: procurement asked also if we can accept a partial delivery (2 nodes) now and remainder in 3w — BareCloud allowed partial.
jin: partial delivery of 2 nodes would cover the demo (2 nodes x 2 GPUs = 4 GPUs) if they are configured as single-node 4-GPU boards. confirm with vendor.
mike: I'll ask vendor for "single-node 4x H100" or equivalent.
oncall: if you go the partial route, I'll create a cross-project firewall/route so demo traffic stays isolated. need ticket.
mike: opening ticket now: INFRA-6721 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-6721)
sara: procurement updated — vendor quote attached, asking for PO by EOD tomorrow.
mike: thanks everyone. if procurement gets PO and vendor confirms 2-node single-board config, we should be green. will update here when vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
vendor-bot: [BareCloud] order status update: quote received, holding pricing for 48h. Reference: BC-9012.
jin: small FYI — if vendor can't guarantee single-node layout, fallback is public cloud h100 with local NVLink instance types (expensive).
mike: ok marking action items: 1) vendor confirm single-node layout (mike) 2) procurement prepare PO (sara) 3) finance approval doc (ash) 4) oncall set network ticket (oncall). will report back before EOD tomorrow.
sara: noted. I'll post PO draft here once ready.
nash: thx — shout if we need to convert to cloud burst last minute.
mike: closing loop for now. vendor to confirm today-ish, I'll ping again if not.
